contexts.text: The Angels confess that there is nothing of Power with them...
Hand = power, also Power...
The Word does not treat of monarchical Powers.
As to Power being given to the Son of Man... it is to be known that the Lord had Power over all things... before He came into the world. Explained.
(Evil Spirits) suppose that they can contribute much to the Lord's Power and dominion...
That they were given into their Power. Signified, Explained.
That this Rational was under the Power of the affection of truth... Signified.
To sit at the right hand of Divine power = to have all Power in the Heavens and on earth.
Preface. [2]. Peter never exercised such Power... But faith in the Lord... has this Power...
Arrogate to themselves the Power of saving the human race.
The papal Power might have been dissipated... Explained.
They did not want to know that the Power given to the Lord's Human... shows it to be Divine.
Absolute Power. Signified.
Reduced under absolute Power. Signified, Explained.
That the Power should not recede from the Celestial Kingdom. Signified, Explained.
A sceptre is the ensign of the royal Power.
The Angels of that Kingdom have indeed great Power, but in proportion as they are in the Lord's Divine Human through love to Him.
Hence it is that the Angels, because they are in good, have such great Power over infernal Spirits that...
The Power of opening Heaven... belongs to the Lord alone... All Power in the other life is through the truth of faith from good. LJ 57:2.
That the Lord has all Power in Heaven and on earth. Signified, Explained.
I give you Power to tread on serpents... and over all the Power of the enemy (). These words describe the Lord's Power over the Hells...
The Lord and His Power over all things in Heaven and on earth. Treated of.
Priests are not to claim for themselves any Power over the souls of men... still less the Power of opening and shutting Heaven; because this Power belongs to the Lord alone.
The king who has absolute Power... is a tyrant.
One rages against another who derogates from his divine Power.
They believe that the Lord's Power... has been transferred into Peter.
They were convinced... that the Lord alone has this Power, because it is Divine Power.
Concerning the (papal) Power.
I will give him Power over the nations () = that they shall conquer in themselves the evils which are from Hell. AE 175.
Thou art worthy to receive... Power () = that the Lord has the Kingdom. ( = salvation. AE 293.)
Worthy is the Lamb to receive Power () = that the Lord as to the Divine Human has omnipotence. AE 338.
There was given him the Power of killing... () = the destruction of all good.
There was given them Power as the scorpion of the earth have Power () = the power of persuading that their falsities are truths.
Their Power is to hurt men five months () = that they can induce a stupor... AE 561.
Their Power was in their mouth () = that they prevail only by discourse which confirms faith. AE 580.
Power was given to (this beast) () = dominion. AE 803.
He exercises all the Power of the first beast () = that they confirmed the dogmas...
See Power.
Having great Power () = a strong influx. ( = omnipotence. AE 1093.)
Over these the second death has no Power () = that they are not damned.
That their Power be in the tree of life () = to the end that they be in the Lord and the Lord in them, through love...
Power in that tree = Power from the Lord...
The Angels have such Power, that if they merely want, they obtain.
There are (in Heaven) governments and forms of government, and therefore there are greater and lesser Powers and dignities.
Rivalry between consorts concerning right and Power. Explained.
If they extend their Power beyond what is right.
That the Power of the devil is mere phantasy...
That the Lord can be honoured by the worst devils if He promises them Power.
They said they have all the Lord's Power... SE 5650.
b. They said the Lord has no Power, because He has given it all to them...
A certain (infernal) was given Power over many, and was told that he should enjoy this Power if he would acknowledge the Lord. He then acknowledged with such fervour...
He confessed... that if he had had absolute Power, he would have...
Concerning kings and queens who believe that they have absolute Power, and have the lives of men in their Power.

Why they say that the Power which belonged to His Human was given Him by the Father... It was because they have transferred to themselves all His Divine Power... (Thus) they no longer attribute any Power to the Lord.

Benedict XIV... had believed that the Lord has no Power, because He had transferred it all into Peter and thence into his successors; and (that) their saints have more Power than the Lord, because they retain it from God the Father; whereas the Lord has abdicated all, and given it to the Pontiffs.
To have Power over ten cities = intelligence and wisdom.

The reason Power, here, = salvation, is that all Divine Power regards this as the end; for man is reformed by the Divine Power... Those who claim this Power do not know what salvation is... To claim Divine Power is to claim Power over the Lord Himself, which Power is called the Power of darkness ().
That Power, when said of the Lord, principally regards salvation. Illustrated.
Moreover, the Lord has Power over all things, because He is the only God; but the salvation of the human race is the Principal of Power. Explained.
The Powers of the heavens () = the Word in the sense of the letter. Explained.
Power = the effect, because to be able is to effect.
The Power to do this deed the Lord calls the Power of darkness. Explained.
Power = power and effect...
A city = doctrine; and to have Power over it = to be intelligent and wise.
The Power of the enemy = cunning.
These have Power to shut heaven (). Explained.
They have Power over waters... (). Explained.

Now is... the power... of our God, and the Power of His Christ () = that now the Lord has power to save those who... Power = that He can; thus the possibility... and the Power of His Christ = the efficacy of Divine truth. References.
The Power to be the sons of God (). Explained.
Power = worth-valor; and great Power = strengthening and corroboration thence.
Such Power it has sometimes been granted me to see...
Falsities have Power in those who are in falsities from evil...
The Power of the beast from the dragon = the strengthening and corroboration of this dogma...
The Power of acting () = the act of destroying goods and truths. Explained.
Having Power over fire (). Explained.
Having Power over these plagues () = no fear of the Last Judgment... To have Power, when said of God, ... = the Lord as to the Last Judgment.
As they knew that all Power belongs to the Lord alone...
They rejected the Lord, if the Power was not granted them...
They who in the world have exercised the Divine Power of the Lord...

They have transferred the Divine Power of the Lord into the Pope... So that they could say that they have not taken His Divine, but His Human, Power; not wanting to know that the Divine Power principally consists in the Power of saving the human race, which Power the Babylonians appropriate.
The truth adulterated... by the Lord's Power over Heaven and earth... being transferred into their supreme one, and from him to the rest under him. Signified. AE 1143.
The truth profaned by the Lord's Power over Heaven and earth, as assumed by them, being said not to be Divine. Signified.

They say that the Power over Heaven... is not Divine, because it was the Power of the Lord's Human transferred to Him by God the Father, and by the Lord into Peter... Still this Power is Divine; (for) after God created the universe, it is the Primary of Divine Power to deliver men from Hell and save them... and human Power can contribute nothing whatever to this.
